[Ronald Coase](http://organizationsandmarkets.com/2010/12/09/ronald-coases-new-book/ "Ronald Coase") turns 100 later this month and has a book out in June on China:

> *How China Became Capitalist controversially argues that China’s growth potential will be inhibited in future without a vibrant market in ideas.*
